Maya: Heads-up: profiling run on dedicated INT8 rollout showed ~12% lower throughput and weird KV cache misses when calibration enabled. Looking to expose knobs in SDK + doc guidance. Details below.
Alex: Can you paste numbers and config?
Maya: Summary: model=rw-13B-8k, seq=2048, batch=4; baseline FP16 tokens/s=2100; INT8+calib tokens/s=1850; tail latency p95 jumped 90ms->160ms. KV cache miss-rate ~0.14 vs 0.03 baseline. Repro command:
```
run_profile --model rw-13b --quant int8 --calibrate true --batch 4 --seq 2048 --out perf.json
```
Jordy: I think kernel selector is falling back to generic matmul for a hot path due to calibration introducing per-layer scale tensors not supported by int8 fast path. That causes extra copy to CPU for scales.
Maya: Yep, trace shows fallback on attn kernel layer 6-9. Also KV cache layout differs when quantized as we store scaled int8 cache which current cache hash doesn't consider -> cache misses.
Sasha: Proposal: expose SDK flags: `quant.preset` ('safe','speed','aggressive'), `quant.calibration` (on/off), `quant.calibration_mode` ('per-channel','per-tensor'), `quant.force_kernel` ('prefer_fast','prefer_stable'), `quant.kv_layout` ('auto','legacy'). Defaults -> safe. Safety rail: disable aggressive fast path if cache_miss_rate>0.05 during warmup.
Alex: Docs: need migration guide + sample code. Suggest example snippet and recommended thresholds. Also add a console warning when runtime auto-falls back.
Maya: Sample SDK snippet:
```
client.generate(
  model="rw-13b",
  quant={"preset":"safe","calibration":false},
  runtime={"force_kernel":"prefer_stable","batching":{"max_batch_tokens":4096}}
)
```
Jordy: Also record per-request `kv_schema_version` in traces and expose in Console; will help rollback.
ops-bot: canary deploy started: dedicated/cluster-3 -> canary 10% (deploy-id: canary-1769123600) :rocket:
Sasha: :thumbsup: I'll draft doc PR + CLI flags. Can we add an automated calibration checker to Optimize that does a lightweight calibrate and reports perf delta?
Maya: Yup, behind feature flag. Canary for 48h. Abort criteria: perf delta < -5% or cache_miss_rate>0.05.
Alex: I'll add SDK type defs + unit/perf tests and a perf-harness regression. Ping me if you need traces.
Maya: Thanks — will post perf.json and traces after warmup. @Sasha @Jordy can you coordinate docs + console changes?
Sasha: On it, starting a PR.
